41 of 44 PDFs were renamed to `YYYY-MM-DD_vendor.pdf`. Three were skipped and keep their original names: `scan_0012.pdf`, `scan_0013.pdf`, and `IMG_2231.pdf`.

All three are image-only scans with no text layer, so I couldn't read an invoice date or vendor from them. To rename them, I can either run OCR on them or you can give me the date and vendor for each. OCR can misread digits in dates, so I'd have you check those names.
